description: A multiplayer top-down farming game where players buy seeds of varying rarity from a gear shop, plant them in shared garden plots, watch them grow, and sell the harvest at the sell shop for coins.

layout.gardens: 2x2 grid center of map — top-left (-4,3), top-right (4,3), bottom-left (-4,-3), bottom-right (4,-3)
